title: Paper 2: confirmation on Chaksu Test of the fundus-aware crop, residual seed dependence and label-free model selection by TTA consistency
nature: engineering localisation-accuracy study; confirmatory single run on held-out data
data: Chaksu Test, 336 images (Bosch 41, Forus 31, Remidio 264), devices absent from FE training; never processed by any FE model before this run
reference: STAPLE disc mask (Majority as sensitivity), locked in results/fe/chaksu_ref_test/reference_lock.json without any FE model
development_basis: all methods and settings were chosen on Chaksu Train (post hoc development after the locked Train evaluation); development files hashed below

fixed_settings.R1m: fe/p2c_crop.py: largest bright component (gray > 15) after binary opening (3 iterations), 1.02 margin, outside-component pixels blanked
fixed_settings.failure: centre more than 0.2 r_d from the reference centre (r_d at 384 in the same crop), or no centre
fixed_settings.pipelines: onfm/frame.py deployed pipelines, TTA thresholds research 0.138 and product 0.297 r_d, not recalibrated
fixed_settings.label_free_score: per-model TTA flag rate on the unlabelled Test images (each of the nine models through the deployed TTA code on R1m, track thresholds as above)

hypotheses.H1: fundus-aware crop reduces failure of the deployed pipelines: paired exact McNemar R1m vs R0 per track, Holm over the two tracks; success if fewer R1m failures and adjusted p < 0.05
hypotheses.H2: seed dependence persists under R1m: Cochran Q over seeds 42/43/44 per track, Holm; meaningful if adjusted p < 0.05 and max-min seed failure >= 5 percentage points
hypotheses.H3: label-free selection: Spearman correlation across the nine models between TTA flag rate and failure of the TTA frames on R1m, exact permutation p over 9!; success if rho > 0 and p < 0.05

secondary: per track, whether the seed with the lowest TTA flag rate is the seed with the fewest failures; its coverage and failures among unflagged frames; overall and per device
per-device results (Bosch 41 and Forus 31 descriptive only)
seed dependence under R0 (replication of the Train finding)
Spearman with median TTA spread; self-detection of the deployed pipelines under R0 and R1m; number of reference radii above 46 px under R1m
interpretation_note: Remidio contributes 264 of 336 images; per-device results are reported alongside pooled results. Each hypothesis is reported as met or not met.
single_evaluation: fe/p2c_test_locked_eval.py runs once; refuses on any hash or crop mismatch or if results exist

selftest.result: R1m crop identical to development; Test reference 336 loaded, R0 crop parity 0; on 15 Train images R0 results identical to the locked Train run and R1m TTA identical to development (0 failure mismatches)
